response.sql: SELECT SUM(g - l) AS total_games_minus_losses, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half WHERE w > 26;

assumptions.assumption: Records are counted by the w > 26 filter alone, so records with missing g or l are included in the count. SUM(g - l) skips rows where the difference is NULL, which is how missing values are ignored in the total.
A NULL w fails the w > 26 test and is excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only the records that contribute to the total, meaning those with w > 26 and non-missing g and l.
alternatives.sql: SELECT SUM(g - l) AS total_games_minus_losses, COUNT(g - l) AS record_count FROM manager_half WHERE w > 26;
